I’m saving links in browser folders, notes, and messages to myself, so they’re scattered and hard to find again. I want one personal place where I can quickly save a link, organise it, search for it later, and keep track of what I still want to read. I’d also like to avoid ending up with duplicates when I save the same link twice.
